newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher, NY fails to inspire.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher, NY fails to inspire.

text.p: White sugar futures held on to most of their earlier gains on Friday afternoon but the long-awaited boost from the New York market failed to materialise, traders said.
At 1610 GMT nearby positions were slightly firmer, with August up $1.40 at $308.50 and October up 80 cents at $304.00. Volume was on the light side at 1,120 lots.
"It's hard to forecast what London will do," said one trader. "August/October widened with the rolling into August prior to the May expiry and it might slide down in the next few days."
Nearby spreads have reverted to their normal backwardation down the futures board but traders said the market still needed time to stabilise after the gyrations wreaked by last week's whites expiry.
"You've just had an expiry of the spot month and it always takes around two or three weeks for the market to establish itself once again," said another trader.
Traders said the market was still looking for confirmation of results from South Africa's recent selling tender.
In Paris volume stayed thin at 93 lots.
August was up 70 cents at $307.50 and October was untraded.
